brief.headline: Ukraine's Wildberries drone strikes rattle channels; Kyiv hit in return
brief.lead: A large Ukrainian drone barrage on Wildberries logistics warehouses in Tambov and Moscow regions dominated the day, driving sentiment on strikes-inside-Russia sharply negative even as channels touted record-scale Russian missile strikes on Kyiv. The rare mix of anger, defensiveness, and self-criticism over economic vulnerability set the tone.

developments.title: Ukrainian drones hit Wildberries warehouses; 7 killed
developments.body: Multiple channels reported a 370+ drone attack on the Moscow region and Tambov, with Wildberries logistics centers hit; claimed tolls range from 7 killed and 24-48 wounded (Rybar/WarGonzo) with some citing 61 injured. Channels allege deliberate targeting of civilian workers with cluster munitions — an unconfirmed framing.

developments.title: Channels claim record-scale missile strike on Kyiv
developments.body: NgP raZVedka posted a series of escalating figures — 16, 23, 30, 33, and 37 missiles — framing the barrage as a record single strike overwhelming Ukrainian air defenses and hitting metro stations and a Wildberries facility. Figures are inconsistent, unconfirmed, and single-sourced.

developments.title: Russia claims sustained strikes on Ukrainian ports
developments.body: Two Majors, Poddubny, and Kotsnews claimed Russian Geran drones and missiles damaged three cargo ships at Odesa/Yuzhny and hit fuel infrastructure and a Neptune-2 launcher near Chornomorsk and Snake Island; Kotsnews cited 19 group strikes on ports July 11-17. Claims unconfirmed.

developments.title: Air-defense capacity debate surfaces amid attacks
developments.body: Two Majors and Kotsnews both cited 1,892 drones intercepted over Russia in one week — Kotsnews framed it as proof of effective PVO, while Two Majors questioned air-defense capacity against concentrated attacks, an unusually candid split.

developments.title: FSB claims arrest of two Crimean women as SBU recruits
developments.body: Kotsnews, Starshe Eddy, and Poddubny relayed an FSB report that two Crimean women were recruited by Ukraine's SBU for sabotage and intelligence-gathering. Single official source repeated across channels.

developments.title: Rybar claims 50th settlement taken in border zone
developments.body: Rybar said the Northern grouping 'liberated' its 50th settlement across Sumy and Kharkiv regions, framing it as expanding the border security zone. Unconfirmed; no independent corroboration among channels.

narrative_watch.title: Ukraine 'deliberately targets civilians and economy'
narrative_watch.body: Channels frame the Wildberries warehouse strikes as intentional attacks on civilian workers and economically significant objects, alleging cluster munitions to underscore malice.

narrative_watch.title: Self-criticism: Russian business shirks the war
narrative_watch.body: NgP raZVedka and Rybar argue Wildberries strikes expose big Russian businesses that avoid supporting the war, and contrast bureaucratic slowness with Ukraine's decisiveness.

narrative_watch.title: Kyiv strikes framed as justified retaliation
narrative_watch.body: NgP raZVedka casts massed strikes on Kyiv as consequences Ukraine 'suffers' for hitting Russian civilian infrastructure, normalizing tit-for-tat escalation.

mood_lines.text: Sharply negative (net -68, swing -168) after Wildberries warehouse attacks and mounting civilian casualty claims dominated the feed.
Uniformly celebratory: record-scale Kyiv missile claims and sustained port strikes framed as effective retaliation and logistics degradation.
Mixed but improved (swing +77): schadenfreude over Trump, EU LNG purchases, and Georgian hostility to Ukraine offset alarm at Black Sea recon.
Positive on FSB counterintelligence arrests and Belousov's collegium; society debate on comfort versus war effort adds neutral texture.
Steadily positive claims of advances in Sumy, Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia and drone strikes on logistics near Red Liman; no reversals reported.
Fully negative: bureaucratic slowness and large businesses avoiding war support singled out following the warehouse strikes.

flag_texts.title: Strikes-on-Russia sentiment collapses (-168)
flag_texts.body: The Wildberries warehouse attacks drove net sentiment to -68 with 16 of 19 posts negative, a 168-point swing reflecting genuine alarm and anger over economic and civilian targeting.

flag_texts.title: West & NATO mood turns positive (+77)
flag_texts.body: Sentiment rose to net +14 on posts mocking Trump, highlighting continued EU LNG purchases from Yamal, and noting Georgian public hostility to Ukraine.

flag_texts.title: Russia-internal sentiment up (+50)
flag_texts.body: FSB arrests of two alleged SBU-recruited Crimean women and coverage of Belousov's collegium meeting pushed internal sentiment to net +50.

flag_texts.title: Watchlist items quiet
flag_texts.body: No posts on 'Mobilisation rumours' or 'Criticism of Putin' today; the day's criticism focused on bureaucracy and war-shirking businesses rather than leadership.
